gloss: to reach an extreme; to be at its height

definitions.gloss: to reach an extreme; to be at its height; to be stuck
definitions.explanation: To reach the furthest point or limit of something. Mostly found in set phrases and after a noun or na-adjective stem, where it means 'extremely'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感|かん}{極|きわ}まって→感極まる：19265_kankiwamaru⟧⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}した→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧。
examples.english: Overcome with emotion, she burst into tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧{極|きわ}まる⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧だ。
examples.english: That is an extremely rude attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦{極|きわ}まりない→極まりない：32778_kiwamarinai⟧⟦{夜道|よみち}→夜道：17541_yomichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: They each walked home alone along an extremely dangerous road at night.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧{極|きわ}まる: to be overcome with emotion
- {進退|しんたい}{極|きわ}まる: to be stuck, with no way forward or back
- 〜{極|きわ}まる / 〜⟦{極|きわ}まりない→極まりない：32778_kiwamarinai⟧: extremely ~ (⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧{極|きわ}まる, ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦{極|きわ}まりない→極まりない：32778_kiwamarinai⟧)

WATCH OUT:
〜⟦{極|きわ}まりない→極まりない：32778_kiwamarinai⟧ is not a negative: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦{極|きわ}まりない→極まりない：32778_kiwamarinai⟧ means 'extremely dangerous', the same as ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧{極|きわ}まる.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Transitive partner: ⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to master; to carry to the extreme)

forms.negative: {極|きわ}まっていませんでした
